title: DAL-P08 - Immutable post-final analysis, claim freeze, and paper evidence packaging
outcome: Classify every remaining P08 analysis by immutable evidence availability, generate only source-bound post-final derivatives that require no new final-test inference or policy change, freeze the paper claim ledger, and package reproducible paper evidence without hiding null, negative, blocked, failure, or calibration-pathology outcomes.
rationale: SG-000022 is canonically closed after the one-shot final evaluation and evidence promotion. P08 still has open reporting and paper-evidence tasks, but final outcomes can no longer be used to change the experiment. SG-000023 therefore begins with an evidence-availability matrix that separates valid derivations from analyses that are blocked or unavailable, then permits only immutable-evidence analysis and claim packaging under a permanent no-rerun/no-tuning boundary.
scope_in: Consume canonical SG-000022 final evidence under registry/p08_sg000022_final_evaluation and already-frozen qualified pre-final development/calibration evidence
Create a machine-readable evidence-availability matrix for every remaining P08 task before generating claims or paper artifacts
Classify each requested analysis as available, blocked, unavailable, or not-applicable with exact source evidence and reason
Generate paper tables and figures only from versioned canonical evidence with exact run/hash provenance
Generate risk-coverage and reliability reporting only where the underlying evidence supports the metric semantics
Preserve Laya uncalibrated-confidence limitations and exclude affected confidence from calibrated-confidence claims
Report frozen ECAL development/calibration selection and ablation evidence without reselecting components or inventing final-test ablations
Report evidence-intervention and counterfactual results only to the level supported by qualified immutable real-data evidence; otherwise record blocked/unavailable
Preserve FHIR-AgentBench as the canonical interface-blocked final result while distinguishing prior representation qualification from final action-selection performance
Produce preregistered distribution-shift slices only where canonical source fields and pre-result semantics support valid analysis
Produce deterministic failure taxonomy and qualitative examples under a selection rule frozen before example inspection
Report efficiency only where already-canonical evidence satisfies p08-hardware-stratified-v0.1; otherwise mark direct efficiency claims unsupported
Create evidence packets and a machine-readable claim ledger using candidate, supported, null, rejected, blocked, and exploratory states
Map every affirmative manuscript, README, release, and abstract claim to evidence packet IDs before export
Refresh related work before final claim freeze and narrow/remove novelty claims when concurrent work closes a gap
Use zero-founder-cost tooling and execution only
Exact-head cross-platform CI plus Alibaba OpenCodeReview and secure TypeSafe Jev review for activation, implementation, evidence promotion, and closeout boundaries
scope_out: No rerun of SG-000022 final-test inference
No new final-test model inference using SG-000022 test labels or source rows
No model/backbone/checkpoint/seed retraining, fine-tuning, replacement, merging, or reselection
No calibration or threshold refit from final outcomes
No FHIR representation reselection or new FHIR action adapter
No benchmark membership, denominator, exclusion-rule, coverage-target, metric, bootstrap, comparison-family, multiplicity, hardware-protocol, or failure-accounting changes
No post-hoc p-value construction or significance testing that was not preregistered
No post-outcome invention of subgroup or distribution-shift slices
No manual cherry-picking of qualitative examples
No silent omission of unfavorable, null, blocked, failed, timeout, OOM, parse, interface, or calibration-pathology evidence
No clinical-safety, regulatory-readiness, deployment-fitness, superiority, significance, or SOTA claim without separately qualified evidence
No founder-paid compute, APIs, SaaS, or reviewers
